product: Outfit planner app that scans your closet and builds looks from the clothes you already own

banned_topics: negative framing of a named brand or influencer
rules.tone: A young woman sharing what actually makes an outfit look put together, plain sentences, warm, never a sales pitch.

guidance.hook_style: A count plus the promise: easy ways to look classy and put together, fashion mistakes that cheapen a look, outfit ideas. Sentence case.
angles: easy ways to look classy and put together (fit, neat hair, curated pieces, skin and scent, nails, sunglasses, posture)
fashion mistakes that cheapen a look (wrinkles, over-accessorising, loud branding, clashing aesthetics, cheap-looking fabrics, poor fit)
notes: Attire appears once as a tip: an app like Attire builds the combos from what you already own
the closer is the last numbered item, then save for later / follow for more
old-money palette: cream, camel, black, brown
